name: humanize
description: Revise written material for a natural, context-aware voice while preserving meaning and format by default.

interface.shortDescription: Revise prose for a natural, context-aware voice
interface.longDescription: Revise pasted text or text-bearing files for specificity, natural rhythm, audience fit, and an established author, team, or repository voice while preserving meaning, evidence, and document structure by default.

Revise this file to match our repository's voice.
